text:
After our biggest meetup yet in October, we're excited to bring everyone together again for a morning of furry friends, fun, and giving back!

📅 Sunday, November 22, 2026
⏰ 10:00 AM – 12:00 PM
📍 Highland Park – Near 30th Street Station

Located along JFK Boulevard between 3001 and 3025 JFK Boulevard, directly beneath the elevated rail line. The park features a designated dog park area, so bring your furry friends for some playtime, socializing, and making new friends!

RSVP Via Link in Bio!

A Season of Giving Thanks & Giving Back!

November is all about gratitude, and we want to use this meetup to help dogs in need!

We're encouraging everyone to bring donations of dog food, toys, and treats to support dogs in need.

As a thank-you for your generosity, everyone who donates will receive a raffle ticket for a chance to win our special goodie basket!

Can't Bring a Donation? You Can Still Help!

If you'd prefer not to carry items to the meetup, you can donate money instead! 

Venmo: @jenmaher14 - Last four digits: 9144

Please include "Philly Shih Tzus November Donation" in the payment note so we can keep track of contributions. Monetary donations will also qualify you for a raffle ticket!

We can't wait to see everyone on November 22nd!
